thread:
omar: hey! on my first-day run of the onboard pipeline the image push step errors with 403 when pushing to ghcr.io. I'm on hosted Buildkite agents. any tips?

ci-bot: build #1 started on agent-12

jen: welcome omar :wave: GH App alone typically doesn't cover GHCR package permissions. You need either org-level package access for the app or a token with read:packages/write:packages.

omar: hmm the onboarding guide mentioned the app but not GHCR perms. is OIDC an option here?

jen: Buildkite supports GitHub OIDC but it's more common in GH Actions. For hosted Buildkite agents we usually either: 1) create a machine user PAT (scoped to packages), store it in the team vault as GHCR_TOKEN, 2) publish base images to our ECR and use AWS creds, or 3) enable the app package access in the org settings.

infra: quick note: avoid long-lived PATs if you can. If you must use one for onboarding, make it repo-scoped and rotate after 24h. We also have a short-lived onboarding machine token you can request via the access portal.

omar: I added a temporary GHCR_TOKEN via vault and retried. Now docker login passes but the docker build fails with "manifest unknown" for tag onboard-latest.

jen: either update the Dockerfile to a public tag (e.g., python:3.10-slim) for the onboarding flow or we can publish the onboard base image to ghcr with that tag. For speed, swap to public base.

omar: swapped, build proceeded but cache restore step times out pulling from S3 (request canceled). Is that a separate infra thing?

infra: we're seeing intermittent S3 egress errors in the hosted agent pool. For now, skip cache restore in the onboarding pipeline (set restore: false) or run on an elastic queue in us-west-2. We'll investigate and follow up.

omar: thanks all. will file an access request for the short-lived token and update the onboarding README with the public base suggestion. appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
